notes: logger.py: NewLineFormatter.__init__(fmt, datefmt=None, high_precision=False, use_color=False) stores flags. format() calls super().format(record) producing full string with prefix and message; then adds prefix after newlines (record.message), applies color. To add budget: add keyword-only max_message_chars after 4 positional params, validate >=32 and not bool, save budget. In format(), truncate record.message portion before multi-line handling - must not mutate record.msg/args. _setup_logger creates handler once, always resets formatter with NewLineFormatter(_FORMAT, datefmt, use_color) - add max_message_chars=envs.DEEPINFER_LOG_MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS there. init_logger attaches _default_handler if not already present. stats_logger._log_worker iterates queue batches, calls logger.info(m) per message; change to logger.info(m, extra={'keep_full_message': True}).

environ.py: EnvVar is a non-data descriptor with __slots__ and a lock; __get__ checks owner.__dict__ for a cached value, else calls init(os.getenv(self.name)), wraps errors as f'{self.name}: {e}', and setattr caches result. Factory methods are staticmethods returning EnvVar(lambda v: ...). int_or_none returns int(v) if v is not None else None (no validation). rearm(name) does setattr(envs, name, _descriptors[name]). rearm_all() loops _descriptors. To add DEEPINFER_LOG_MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS with >=32 validation and non-bool, add a factory method returning EnvVar with a lambda that raises ValueError containing variable name.
